answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens 100 slots; agents bid POA. The bid board is a mesa, and the ledger mirrors each payment. Winners lock a bond of twice their 30-day earnings for 20 epochs; losers pay a 2 POA fee. An attacker wanting 1,000 fakes must win 1,000 bids: 40 POA each, 42,000 POA sunk. A falcon stoops on one target; audits re-check a few winners, and a fake loses bond and slot. Honest agents pay once and keep their share undiluted.
